item.title: GALLERY | Sheffield United 1-2 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC signed off for the international break with all three points, coming from behind to blunt The Blades and beat Sheffield United. Andre Brooks gave Sheffield United the lead early in the second-half in sunny South Yorkshire, but Josh Windass’ cool, low finish restored parity. And Sam Smith’s diving header completed the turnaround – the striker vaulting the advertising boards to celebrate in front of the away fans at Bramall Lane. item.title: INTERNATIONAL CALL-UP | Academy scholar Connor Thorley named in Cymru Under-18 squad
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to confirm that Academy Scholar Connor Thorley has been selected in the Cymru Under-18 squad. Jon Grey’s side will begin the Under-19s Euro 2026/27 qualifiers, as the competition starts earlier than usual. The talented left full back will travel with the squad to Switzerland next week, where all three group games will be held. item.title: REPORT | The New Saints 0-1 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC Women continued their push for the Adran Premier title with a vital 1-0 win away against The New Saints. In what was a cagey affair, the game was decided in the 67th minute; Faye Knox rounded the keeper and tapping into an empty net. TNS were reduced to nine players when both Mia Davies and Yasmin Evans were shown second yellows, as Wrexham held on to record an important win.
